R4E-grouse-drive-0002.recDirections: Accessible by 2wd vehicle down 38km of dirt road. CB Radio Recommended. Access is through the town of Radium Hot Springs. From the HWY 93/95 roundabout in Radium Hot Springs turn west onto Foresters Landing rd. In 1.4 km turn left onto Horsethief Creek FSR and follow for 9km. (Radio controlled road, use RR-4) Following signs for Cartwright Lake, turn right onto Westside rd and continue for 26km to km marker 41.5, turn left onto Leadqueen Frances FSR, following sign for Cartwright Lake. Stay on the Leadqueen FSR for 3.5km, keeping right at forks. Take a right at the fork just before km marker 45 to turn off the Leadqueen FSR onto an unnamed rd and in 300 meters another right at the next fork onto an another unnamed rd. Follow for approximately 1km to Halfway Lake Recreation site sign and turn right into the Recreation Site.

flags.t: MU (Management Unit) 4-34, Region 4 Kootenay.

Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).

plan: Drive: from Village of Radium Hot Springs, about 36 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Forsters Landing Rd, Horsethief Creek FSR, Westside Rd, Leadqueen FSR.
Park: 50.77548, -116.39955, pull off on Leadqueen FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 390 m SW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 26 m, about 10 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: moose, Sept, Oct (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 4-34, Region 4. No baiting in Region 4. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-01, closures 2026-10-16.
